palette.name: master-v0.2
palette.note: Named ramps, light to dark. Actor/FX/UI and terrain are separate groups so the terrain can stay low-contrast. 01 used one 48-color list with single-char keys; 02 maps per-sprite keys to these names (see pixel-source_art-b02.json).

note: Each sprite has its own key map (char -> palette ramp.index). Player layers keep the hand-authored keys.
